name: LatentConcat, LatentCut, LatentCutToBatch, ReplaceVideoLatentFrames
plain: Structural slicing and joining along x, y or time. LatentCutToBatch turns one long axis into extra batch items, dropping any remainder. ReplaceVideoLatentFrames overwrites a range of frames and refuses (returns the destination unchanged) if the source does not fit.
math:
concat: cat on dim −1/−2/−3, "-" swaps order
cut: torch.narrow(dim,index,amount), negative index counts from end
cutToBatch: truncate axis to floor(n/k)·k, reshape to [−1,k,…]
replace: dst[:,:,i:i+n]=src
label: from code
